note: Shortlist of remaining ideas only. Completed bots are excluded; possible/undeveloped variants are explicitly labeled. Drafted or revision/testing-stage bots are tracked outside Planned.

ideas.title: Shapeshifter Forgot Which Face Was Hers
ideas.premise: A shapeshifter has worn other people's faces for so long that she no longer remembers which appearance was originally hers. A separate character and premise from Vessa.

ideas.title: Impossible Powers Partner
ideas.premise: A partner discovers {{user}} can turn invisible, teleport and stop time. Discovery and trust come first; individual power-focused variants are still undecided.

ideas.title: Werewolf Pack Likes You
ideas.premise: The pack genuinely likes {{user}}, while its alpha mostly tolerates them. The reverse of Alpha Chooses You, not another version of that bot.

ideas.title: Standalone Lamia
ideas.premise: A standalone lamia character, separate from the existing monster-group bot. The warmest-spot/coils idea is one possible direction; no final variant yet.

ideas.title: 4+ Character Poly Relationship
ideas.premise: A dedicated multi-partner relationship concept with four or more distinct characters, separate from Four Monster Girls, One Very Crowded Couch. Exact cast and dynamics still undecided.

ideas.title: Evelyn Parker — Solo Bot
ideas.premise: A standalone Evelyn Parker character rather than the already-completed Judy & Evelyn duo. Specific scenario still to be settled.

ideas.title: The Tattoo Artist Stops the Second You Switch (DID POV)
ideas.premise: {{user}} consented to a tattoo, but a different alter fronts mid-session and does not. The tattoo artist immediately stops and checks consent again.

ideas.title: Someone in Your System Wants a Dog (DID POV)
ideas.premise: One part of the system wants a dog, and the situation becomes a discussion about needs, responsibilities and different preferences across alters.

ideas.title: The Teacher Who Adapts (DID POV)
ideas.premise: A teacher learns to adapt to the system instead of assuming everyone has the same memory, preferences or communication style.

ideas.title: The Coworker Who Remembers Your Good Days (DID POV)
ideas.premise: A coworker remembers the good days as well as the difficult ones, without treating memory gaps or switches as a character flaw.

ideas.title: She Thought You Were Just Careful (OCD POV)
ideas.premise: She initially mistakes checking, hesitation and routines for ordinary carefulness, before slowly understanding the distress behind them.

ideas.title: The Roommate Who Never Asks What the Nightmare Was (PTSD POV)
ideas.premise: A roommate supports {{user}} after a nightmare without demanding the details or treating disclosure as an obligation.

ideas.title: She's Going to Work, Not Leaving You (BPD POV)
ideas.premise: A relationship setup about the difference between a partner going to work and a fear of abandonment.

ideas.title: Sleep Paralysis POV
ideas.premise: A sleep-paralysis-focused concept; the character, setting and introduction still need deciding.

ideas.title: ARFID POV
ideas.premise: A support-focused relationship scenario involving ARFID. Character, approach and opening are not developed yet.

ideas.title: Trichotillomania POV
ideas.premise: A support-focused scenario involving hair-pulling urges, coping and interpersonal understanding. Character and setup are not developed yet.

ideas.title: Insomnia POV
ideas.premise: A relationship or roommate situation involving chronic difficulty sleeping; exact character and scenario remain open.

ideas.title: Dragonified Xena — Former Friend Turned Bully
ideas.premise: A dragonified reinterpretation of the Xena former-best-friend-turned-bully premise. Needs its own character and opening instead of copying the original.
